decisions.reason: The polymer concrete drain housing extends the firm's proven drainage and installation know-how, allowing it to assimilate early results and improve the product.
As a core floor-level shower drainage system directly building on existing product families and engineering know-how, it is kept.
The designer shower drain leverages existing drainage technology plus design capability, so the firm can interpret market feedback and keep it.
The integrated-slope shower element builds on the firm's installation and waterproofing expertise, making early learning feasible and supporting retention.
The backflow-protected basement floor drain uses proven drainage and safety know-how and was developed in-house, so it is kept.
Although somewhat complementary, the air-admittance valve fits the drainage system portfolio and benefits from related engineering knowledge, so it is retained.
